authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly analyses Bashkarik gaṅgar-būṭ spider under gāṅgaṭa and directs the second member to *buḍḍha, branch 3. These Gawri/Bashkarik responses are therefore represented as both ordered components; vowel, aspiration and final-member b/p variation are retained as survey phonetic qualifications. Mixed spider responses are excluded.
